text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Now that I'm actually touching it like this—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You can really tell a lot from these.
They're crafted to feel so pleasant to the touch—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I wonder... what the material inside is made of?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No... I won't take it apart. After all, you went out of
your way to win it for me, so I'll cherish it.
